title.narrative: Management of Europe House Podgorica and provision of communication services for the EU Delegation to Montenegro

description.narrative: Management of the Europe House in Podgorica and provision of other communication services: the contract is to assist the delegation of the European Union to Montenegro to provide objective and clear information to a wide audience on EU matters, and enhance and promote the visibility of EU policies and EU assistance in Montenegro, including through media monitoring, the production of outreach materials, events and press and public affairs.
